:::{#rem-irreducible-error}
#### What the residual variance does and does not depend on

The [residual variance](#def-irreducible-error) $\varpar$ does not depend on the [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$,
so no choice of [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) using the same [covariates](#def-covariate) can remove it.
It is defined at the single [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$,
so it may differ from one covariate value to another:
it does not assume constant [noise](#def-noise) [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) across covariate values.
For example, in @exm-irreducible-error,
every prediction has [expected squared prediction error](#def-epe) at least $\varpar$.

:::
